card.name: Linking words before skin reaction terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or word endings (and, including, such as, -itis, a comma) just before a named skin reaction such as allergic contact dermatitis or Stevens-Johnson syndrome, in adverse reaction text.

modes.label: Including / such as
modes.description: Linking phrase after 'severe cutaneous adverse reactions' that introduces Stevens-Johnson syndrome.
modes.example: Severe Cutaneous Adverse Reactions: CAMCEVI ETM can cause severe cutaneous adverse reactions (SCARs),<< including>> Stevens-Johnson syndrome/toxic

modes.label: Irritant and allergic
modes.description: The word 'and' joining irritant with allergic contact dermatitis.
modes.example: Irritant<< and>> allergic contact dermatitis may occur.

modes.label: Dermatitis list
modes.description: The ending of dermatitis or a comma within a list of dermatitis types like exfoliative or acneiform.
modes.example: toxic epidermal necrolysis (TEN), dermat<<itis>> acneiform, pruritus and dry
